overall.summary: This is a solid, classic business casual look that's put-together and appropriate. While it's a safe choice, there are a few tweaks that could elevate it from good to great, primarily focusing on fit and subtle details.

hotspots.title: Sweater arm fit
hotspots.detail: The sleeves of the sweater are a bit baggy around the forearms, which makes the overall silhouette look less sharp and tailored.
hotspots.fix: Opt for a sweater with a slightly more tailored fit through the sleeves and body to create a cleaner line.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man wearing a perfectly fitted light grey v-neck sweater, sleeves tailored
visual_suggestions.caption: A sweater with a clean, tailored sleeve fit.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Man in well-fitted light grey v-neck sweater

visual_suggestions.prompt: man in a light grey v-neck sweater, showing ideal sleeve length and width
visual_suggestions.caption: Sleeves that follow the arm's shape without excess fabric.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Close-up of a perfectly fitted sweater sleeve

hotspots.title: Collar definition
hotspots.detail: The white shirt collar peeking out from under the V-neck looks a little soft and could benefit from more structure or a neater tuck.
hotspots.fix: Choose a shirt with a crisper collar or use collar stays to maintain a sharp, defined look that frames your face well.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man in a grey v-neck sweater with a crisp, structured white shirt collar underneath
visual_suggestions.caption: A sharp, well-defined collar under a V-neck.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Man with crisp white collar under grey sweater

visual_suggestions.prompt: close-up of a shirt collar with collar stays under a sweater
visual_suggestions.caption: Collar stays can help maintain a neat shape.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Close-up of shirt collar with collar stays

hotspots.title: Cohesive leathers
hotspots.detail: The matching brown belt and shoes create a well-coordinated and polished element to the outfit, showing attention to detail.
hotspots.fix: Continue to match your leather accessories for a consistently refined and put-together appearance.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man wearing brown leather belt and matching brown leather dress shoes
visual_suggestions.caption: A classic example of matching leather accessories.

visual_suggestions.prompt: detail shot of a brown leather belt buckle and brown dress shoe
visual_suggestions.caption: The subtle coordination elevates the whole look.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Close-up of matching brown leather belt and shoe

hotspots.title: Pant break
hotspots.detail: The pants have a slight break at the ankle, which is acceptable but could be cleaner for a more modern and streamlined silhouette.
hotspots.fix: Consider having the pants hemmed to achieve a minimal or no-break length, allowing them to fall cleanly on your shoes.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man wearing dark tailored trousers with a no-break fit, trousers ending just above the shoe
visual_suggestions.caption: A clean, no-break pant length for a contemporary look.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Man in trousers with no break

visual_suggestions.prompt: man wearing dark tailored trousers with a minimal break, trousers gently touching the top of the shoe
visual_suggestions.caption: A minimal break offers a slightly more traditional, yet still sharp, finish.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Man in trousers with minimal break

hotspots.title: Add visual interest
hotspots.detail: The muted grey and dark trousers create a very safe base, but the outfit could benefit from a touch more visual interest or a subtle pop of color.
hotspots.fix: Introduce a subtle pattern in the shirt, a richer color for the sweater, or a textured accessory to add depth and personality.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man in a rich navy v-neck sweater over a light blue patterned shirt with dark trousers
visual_suggestions.caption: Adding a patterned shirt underneath for subtle interest.
visual_suggestions.alt_text: Man in navy sweater and patterned shirt

visual_suggestions.prompt: man in a burgundy v-neck sweater with a white shirt and dark trousers
visual_suggestions.caption: Experiment with richer sweater colors for a refined pop.

visual_suggestions.prompt: man in a grey v-neck sweater with dark trousers and a textured pocket square
visual_suggestions.caption: A small accessory can introduce texture and color.
